title: Troubleshooting: My World Blue fee wasn't waived
summary: This document explains why the My World Blue monthly maintenance fee ($50.00) may not have been waived for a given statement cycle, based on a $25,000 balance threshold. It covers timing/cutoff rules, multi-currency USD-equivalent effects, intra-period dips, and reversals/adjustments, plus a self-audit and support review process with reversal of the $50.00 if warranted.
faqs: My World Blue was charged $50.00—what should I check on my statement?
Why didn’t my account meet the $25,000 balance requirement for the fee waiver?
Do pending or post-cutoff deposits/credits count toward the waiver evaluation period?
How do multi-currency holdings and FX exchange-rate changes affect the $25,000 threshold?
If my balance dipped below $25,000 during the cycle, can the fee still be waived?
What should I submit to request a waiver review, and will the $50.00 be reversed if corrected?
